always_run.memory: q8 primary; q4 only hard-memory fallback

expansion_rule: For any FAIL, unstable result, or confidence-boundary crossing, expand to all neighboring source-suite cases sharing >=4 of 6 atomic factors; repeat until PASS/FAIL boundary is stable. Full 1018 remains available and is mandatory only when boundary remains unresolved.

production_route_policy.finite_structured: JEV if its validated end-to-end path is faster

quality_policy: Case FAIL maps the capability boundary; it does not invalidate the entire project. Only PASS cells are eligible for min T_VALID competition.
